subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the development-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should this grouped development dependency bump proceed with Socket obfuscated-code warnings for `@emnapi/runtime` and `@react-email/ui`, or should the flagged packages be split or held?
rationale: The warning concerns executable build/test dependencies and requires maintainer security-risk acceptance rather than a purely mechanical code repair.

options.title: Triage Socket First
options.body: Have secops review the two Socket alerts, then either accept the risk and continue or ask for a narrowed dependency update.

options.title: Accept Risk After Formatter Fix
options.body: Maintainers may explicitly accept the Socket warnings, require the `src/styles.css` formatting output, and merge after the required gates pass.

options.title: Split Or Close Group
options.body: If the grouped update is too broad for the flagged packages, close or regenerate narrower Dependabot PRs that isolate the risky dependency changes.

recommendation.title: Triage Socket First
recommendation.body: Have secops review the two Socket alerts, then either accept the risk and continue or ask for a narrowed dependency update.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved question is supply-chain risk acceptance, and CODEOWNERS routes security-sensitive configuration to this team.
